summary: Track 16.10A — Monday-morning Transportation Command Digest certified end-to-end. Backend 42/42 pytest passing (32 static contract + 5 pure builder + 5 live e2e). Live curl verification of all 4 admin endpoints (preview/dry-run/send-now/runs) + unauth gate passed against preview backend. Frontend DigestCard renders inside /admin/transportation/command-queue/health (Automation Health sub-tab) with correct week key transport_command_digest:2026-26, last-run section, 6-cell summary stats grid, all 3 buttons functional, preview pane renders 14KB of HTML. needs_configuration is shown end-to-end. No console errors. Scheduler shown disabled (preview) as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin/transportation/automation/digest/runs returns {count, items: [...]} object instead of a flat list — spec text says 'returns history list'. Both backend test (test_25/test_73) and the frontend already consume the object shape, so this is consistent and not a defect, just worth noting in the API contract docs.

Preview endpoint response shape is richer than the spec listed (also returns generated_at, routes_active, routes_audit_only, routes_needs_configuration, week_start). All required keys (subject, body_text, body_html, summary, sections, week_key, internal_only=true, links) are present — extras are additive and harmless.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Track 16.10A is fully certified and additive on top of Track 16.10. The DigestCard lives at /admin/transportation/command-queue/health below the existing 16.10 Automation Health panels. All API responses are correct and the UI integration works without errors. The route TRANSPORT_COMMAND_DIGEST_WEEKLY is bootstrapped with internal_only=true, enabled=false and shows up under Dry-run routes (25).
